name: Serena Cruz

bio.statement: Cruz's candidate filing lists service as Multnomah County Chief Operating Officer from 2021 to 2024.
Cruz's candidate filing lists service as a Multnomah County Commissioner from 1999 to 2006.
Cruz's voters' pamphlet statement lists degrees from Harvard (MPP), UC Berkeley (JD) and Lewis & Clark (BA).
bio.excerpt: Harvard, MPP; UC Berkeley, JD; Lewis & Clark, BA

source.publisher: Multnomah County Elections (JCVP-01 voters' pamphlet statement)

bio.statement: Cruz's candidate filing lists past work as executive director of the Virginia Garcia Memorial Foundation from 2013 to 2021.
bio.excerpt: Executive Director, Virginia Garcia Memorial Foundation, 2013-21

positions.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Cruz says she will align housing, treatment and support services to get people off the streets.

positions.statement: Cruz told the Portland Mercury that residents have lost confidence local government can deliver basics and are right to demand better.

gaps: No position found on public safety

verification_summary.balance_notes: Source-access disparity, not candidate disparity: the large-print/full pamphlet PDFs are only readable through Broussard and the start of Greene's statements, and the individual statement PDFs for Broussard, Greene, Williams, Ong Norris and Zaghloul are scans with no machine-readable text. Cruz and Robertson have readable individual statements, so they have T1 positions; Williams, Ong Norris and Zaghloul have only T3 (Portland Mercury 2026-09-26) items, and Broussard and Greene mix T1 bio with few positions. Verifier hit the same limits (PDF text truncated at Greene's statement). Same search effort appears applied to all seven; disparity is documented in each file's gaps.
